name: Sign-In Locked Out
description: Presents recovery and alternate authentication choices when password authentication is blocked by account lockout.

conformance.notes: The canonical route contract requires a CommonLinks projection, but no deterministic CommonLinks implementation has been located for this route.
Angular registers the canonical locked-out outcome route and binds it to SigninLockedOutComponent.

Expo Router now exposes the canonical route, but AuthOutcomeScreen still keys its locked-out definition by the legacy /auth/continue/email/locked-out pathname. The canonical route exists but the view binding still needs normalization.

notes: The legacy /auth/continue/email/locked-out path may remain as a compatibility alias after the canonical route is fully bound.
